name: UPPCL LMV-1 urban domestic FY2025-26
source: UPPCL LMV-1 urban domestic, FY2025-26 (UPERC order, Annexure I): 6.50 Rs/kWh above 300 kWh/month; fixed charge Rs 110/kW/month not modelled; export rate NOT from the order

notes: The rate shown is the one the order lists above 300 kWh a month; lower slabs of the order are not loaded, so a small household's bill is overstated.
The export rate is an assumption, not a figure from the order.
